Nichols Canyon Ride (Velo Club La Grange)

Los Angeles, CA · Westwood · Road

Nichols Canyon Ride (Velo Club La Grange) is a road group ride in Los Angeles, CA. It rolls every Sunday at 8:00 am from Raymond Fouquet Square.

About the Nichols Canyon Ride (Velo Club La Grange) group ride

The Sunday club ride of one of LA's oldest and largest cycling clubs, known as the World Famous Nichols Ride. Hard pace with racers in the group, and turnout of 40 to over 100. The club suggests newer riders try one of its easier weekday rides first. Open to non-members. Helmets, lights when dark, no aero bars, no earphones.
